aspect: It is never stated and never has to be
description: Nobody says the reference depends on how you leave. Everyone in professional employment already knows.

aspect: A neutral reference is a bad reference
description: Dates-only is legal, safe and reads to any recruiter as a warning. The sabotage requires no false statement.
'I'm glad you're moving on to something that suits you better. And obviously - anyone calls me, I'll be honest with them.' He smiles. It is the word 'honest' and the pause after it.
energy_note: One word, and she withdraws the grievance.

aspect: It is why most complaints are never filed
description: Fear of reprisal is among the largest reasons people do not report misconduct at all, which means the recorded rate of workplace abuse is a measure of willingness to risk a reference.
energy_note: The statistics count the brave, not the harmed.
